add.evidence: On 9 May 1873, the Vienna Stock Exchange crashed

add.event: Jay Cooke 公司无法销售北太平洋铁路债券
add.evidence: In September 1873, Jay Cooke & Company, a major component of the country's banking establishment, found itself unable to market several million dollars in Northern Pacific Railway bonds.
